news.title: Connections That Count
news.summary: Actuaries are trained to analyze uncertainty for others. Yet, in our experience, we at times fall short when making decisions under uncertainty in our own careers. The actuarial path is viewed primarily through an academic lens, with professional development measured by examinations, technical mastery and continuing education.
